name: Historic Centre of Shakhrisyabz
description: Shakhrisyabz is a city in southern Uzbekistan, about 80 km south of Samarkand, and the birthplace of the conqueror Timur (Amir Temur). Once a major Central Asian centre known as Kesh, it still holds monuments and old neighbourhoods from its 15th-16th century heyday under the Temurids. The site is currently on the List of World Heritage in Danger.
